class: Country reading that stopped at explicit country names: bare cities unknown, alpha-2 codes half-missing, one home only, and descriptions never checked for work-rights demands
fix: reference/cities.json (23 board-seen cities) resolves bare cities; two-letter state codes are stripped before country lookup (boards mean the state); table keys join the index so alpha-2 codes (GB, FR) resolve; load_profile builds accepted_country_codes from home plus available_work_locations and the score veto uses the whole set; matching_engine gates descriptions demanding presence/rights in an unaccepted country (multi-option 'London or New York' passes); stored countries recompute once under a sentinel (COUNTRY_PARSER_VERSION 2). Remote-without-country keeps full credit deliberately: the rights gate covers described postings without punishing the common honest case.
prevention: Location reading is data (countries, states, cities) behind one parser with per-shape tests; stored derivations carry a version and recompute once.
root_cause: f312's parser knew countries and US states only: 'Palo Alto'/'Dublin'/'Vancouver, BC' stayed unknown though the boards name them constantly, 'GB'/'FR' had no reading, second homes were impossible, and a 'Remote' posting demanding another country in its text scored full points.
symptom: Country fetching missed most city-only postings, could not express a second work country, and suggested country-restricted remote jobs whose own text ruled the owner out.
why_tests_missed: f312 tested the shapes its parser knew; no test fed a bare city, an alpha-2 code, a second home, or a rights-demanding description.
